name: Tabula OSK
description:
On-screen keyboard for touch devices, inspired by Windows 11, with an optional Gboard-style phone layout. It has a compact TKL layout with Fn, Ctrl, Alt, AltGr and Super keys, or a phone layout with a number row, long-press accents and symbols and a Material look. It opens by itself on text fields, can suggest words (built-in or from ibus-typing-booster), offers optional swipe typing, capitalizes sentences, types a period on double space, autocorrects English, moves the cursor when you drag on Space, and has a visual layout editor. It also runs on the lock screen so you can type your password there.

Based on Fluent OSK by TbangIT (https://github.com/TbangIT/fluent-osk).
